rows.what_the_ink_shows: The header crop shows n° 574 and underlined 300 exemplaires. The order crop shows Fascicule 0, Recto verso, Page de garde, Lettre L 1 à L 43, Table des Matières T 1 : T 10, instructions to print its last three pages with fascicule 4, and Introduction (i à cxxii). The separate blue-name crop shows LACAN. These copying directions are already present in the original’s separately marked reused right half. Crop reference(s): crops/156-9_scan003_L1097_order.jpg, crops/156-9_scan003_L1097_header.jpg, crops/156-9_scan003_L1097_name.jpg.
rows.note: The original already captures the reproduction-order material, so no textual edit is needed. L1097.R1 limits the local refinement to document type: the right panel is a copying/assembly order listing a table of contents, not itself a mathematical contents outline. The scan alone does not verify identification with Récoltes et Semailles, the edition’s date/structure, or every part of the external H12 claim; those bibliographic claims remain unverified here. Existing uncertainties, including the smaller copy count, are preserved.
